raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce (BIS) has rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China-based exporters of firearms, optics, and related components to the US market, this reduces licensing friction but does not eliminate controls: items may still fall under the USML (ITAR) or the EAR, and end-user/end-use screening, Entity List checks, and HTS/Section 301 tariff exposure remain. Exporters should re-verify classification, license exceptions, and documentation before shipment.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪支出口规则，恢复对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于向美国市场出口枪支、光学瞄具及相关部件的中国出口商而言，这降低了许可摩擦，但并未取消管制：相关物项仍可能属于USML（ITAR）或EAR管辖范围，最终用户/最终用途筛查、实体清单核查以及HTS/301关税风险依然存在。出口商应在发货前重新核实分类、许可例外及单证。

checklist.desc: Re-confirm whether firearms, ammunition, optics, and parts fall under USML categories or EAR ECCNs; document the classification basis and any license exception relied upon after the rule rescission.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List & restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Screen all US consignees, intermediaries, and end users against the BIS Entity List, SDN, and denied party lists; retain screening records and end-use/end-user statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line (e.g., 9302, 9303, 9305) against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin, value build-up, and any exclusion eligibility.

Determine whether an export license or license exception applies; file AES/EEI where required and keep commercial invoice, packing list, and bill of lading consistent with the declared classification.
For electronic sights, rangefinders, or RF-enabled accessories, confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity and supplier FCC IDs before US entry.
Maintain a 5-year audit trail of classification, screening, and license determinations; re-review contracts for ITAR/EAR flow-down clauses after the rule change.
